copy.headline: Generating new ideas and bringing them into interaction are separate channels.
copy.body: Openness shapes the breadth of internal exploration, while extraversion shapes how quickly and frequently that material enters external conversation.
copy.strength_sentence: Separating exploration from expression explains both quiet depth and creativity that develops through speaking.
copy.risk_sentence: Treating expression volume as idea volume can underestimate quiet exploration or overestimate the maturity of immediate expression.
copy.context_boundary: This interaction is clearest in creative collaboration, public expression, and unfamiliar topics; it matters less in familiar independent work.
copy.action_hook: Choose an output format that fits your expression pace, then check whether others actually understood the idea.
